# atlas-driver-scheduler

Shift scheduling tool for the 12 delivery drivers joining **Project Atlas** in February 2027. Owner: **Priya Natarajan**.

It balances morning and afternoon shifts, respects Portuguese working-time rules, and flags gaps one week ahead. The driver hiring shortfall is a top item in the Atlas risk register, so **Joe Smith** reviews the schedule every Monday.
